name: @local/dsh-gputool
description: GPU tool: MCP service for ffmpeg NVDEC/NVENC/Vulkan, ONNX Runtime CUDA (YuNet/SFace), PP-OCRv5, YOLO11 and python jobs, with progress, leases and call history.

scripts.build: npm run build:host && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit && npm run build:client && npm run build:client:pack
scripts.build:rust: CARGO_HOME="$PWD/.cargo-home" cargo build --release --manifest-path rust/face-worker/Cargo.toml && CARGO_HOME="$PWD/.cargo-home" cargo build --release --manifest-path rust/upscale-worker/Cargo.toml && mkdir -p bin && cp rust/face-worker/target/release/gputool-face bin/gputool-face && cp rust/upscale-worker/target/release/gputool-upscale bin/gputool-upscale && CARGO_HOME="$PWD/.cargo-home" cargo build --release --manifest-path rust/ball-worker/Cargo.toml && cp rust/ball-worker/target/release/gputool-ball bin/gputool-ball
scripts.test:rust: CARGO_HOME="$PWD/.cargo-home" cargo test --release --manifest-path rust/face-worker/Cargo.toml && CARGO_HOME="$PWD/.cargo-home" cargo test --release --manifest-path rust/upscale-worker/Cargo.toml && CARGO_HOME="$PWD/.cargo-home" cargo test --release --manifest-path rust/ball-worker/Cargo.toml
